svg.title: ARMORY CASTLE intrusion chain on BeyondTrust Remote Support after CVE-2026-102764
svg.desc: Six steps from Mandiant's October 15, 2026 report. Step one: unauthenticated file upload through CVE-2026-102764, with POST requests to /app_84304470%2Ephp. Step two: the SAWFLY webshell mangoapi.php appears in the Laravel public directory about 11 minutes later. Step three: root through a SUID copy of /bin/sh at /usr/bin/dbus-authd and a post_boot.d script that adds a NOPASSWD sudoers entry. Step four: the appliance vault is dumped with /ns/sbin/bt-secrets and logs are deleted. Step five: a compromised Administrator account raises Jump Item and Team roles to Administrator and opens sessions to internal endpoints. Step six: the BARECLAW tunneler listens on 127.0.0.1:19800 and an haproxy.conf rule exposes it at /uidchanarge.

g.text: POST requests to /app_84304470%2Ephp. Fixed by the BT26-05 patch.
SAWFLY webshell: mangoapi.php, about 11 minutes later
Returns 404 unless the POST carries _c94mfe. Runs as the site service account.
SUID /bin/sh copy at /usr/bin/dbus-authd; post_boot.d/zz-root-persist adds NOPASSWD to sudoers.template
/ns/sbin/bt-secrets get ... vault, then bt-secrets.log, auth.log, http-access.log and others removed
Jump Item and Team roles raised from No Access to Administrator; sessions and file transfers to internal hosts
BARECLAW tunnel behind the appliance's own HAProxy
/tmp/ingredi_ws on 127.0.0.1:19800, reached from the internet at /uidchanarge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: The patch closes step 1 only. Steps 3 to 6 are why Mandiant says to rebuild, then rotate credentials.
